claim: asm2profile names a profile key from the SAVEBIN file name after its first underscore, so a name like hard_drivin_page.bin gives the key drivin_page; name SAVEBINs <short>_page.bin.

evidence.text: hard_drivin_page.bin gave the key drivin_page; renamed hdrivin_page.bin / hdrivin_rom.bin
evidence.quote: asm2profile takes the key from the SAVEBIN name
